q: How do I calculate emissions from autoclave sterilisation in a hospital?
title: Hospital autoclave emissions per cycle
short: Count the steam's boiler fuel, or the electricity of electric steam generators at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, plus vacuum pumps and controls, and divide by cycles run. Biomedical waste sent to a common treatment facility is Scope 3, not part of this figure.

ul: Boiler fuel for steam, shared by sterilisation load.
Electricity for electric autoclaves and vacuum pumps.
Water heating where it is separate.

p: Sterilisation sits inside the hospital's Scope 1 and 2. It is worth tracking per cycle when deciding between a central steam supply and electric units.
Treatment of biomedical waste at a common facility belongs in Scope 3, Category 5, from the facility's invoices.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
